messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 P1 Alert: sudden surge in agent/tool invocations + malformed structured-output responses. Error rate for structured JSON jumps to 82%, runtime queue depth > 90%. Paging oncall @mira.
mira: seeing it — p90 token latency at 4.2s, timeouts at runtime layer. Is this concentrated in a single model or across models?
devin: spread across multiple small models and one popular reranker. hypothesis: cascade from heavy agent-driven loops + some user prompts requesting large structured outputs. Suggest immediate hard stop for external agent calls (global) and fallback to plain text output for streaming sessions.
sylvia: agree with stop-first approach. Also propose per-tenant soft QPS backoff for top 20 tenants to reduce blast radius. I can push a rate-adjust rule to the routing layer.
rachel: telemetry: top 3 tenants account for ~58% of agent calls in last 10m. Most calls originate from hosted API keys (not Dedicated). I'll attach the tenant ids in the follow-up ticket.
mira: ok plan: 1) flip global agent-invoke -> disabled for hosted tier 2) set structured_output_mode=compact for all hosted streaming connections 3) apply per-tenant QPS=0.5 for the 5 heaviest tenants. Doing (1) now. Command I will run in console:```bash
redwoodctl feature-toggle set --name=agent_invoke --value=false --scope=hosted
```
Please stand by for deploy-bot confirmation.
deploy-bot: :gear: Feature toggle applied: agent_invoke=false (scope=hosted). Propagation to edge proxies in progress (~10s per region).
incident-bot: Update logged: mitigation step 1 executed by mira at 1965432135. Monitoring for error rate drop and latency regression.
devin: pushing structured-output fallback:```json
{ "structured_output_mode": "compact", "max_structured_size": 1024 }
```This will reduce heavy JSON serialization. Applying config to streaming router now.
sylvia: rolling in per-tenant QPS caps for listed tenant ids (will log the change). Command:```bash
redwoodctl routing set-qps --tenant=<tenant-id> --qps=0.5
```Starting with top 5.
rachel: customer-impact note: Hosted customers may see agent-based features silently degrade; recommend we surface a brief banner on Console + send temporary status page note. I'll draft copy: "We are temporarily restricting agent integrations and structured JSON output for hosted API to protect stability. Some advanced features may be limited. We expect restoration within 2 hours."
mira: good. I'll also open an incident ticket and assign to eng-runtime to follow up on root cause. Ticket: INF-2026-178.
pagerduty: @mira, I assigned the incident to oncall-dev team, escalation to senior SRE in 15m if no progress.
devin: monitoring: error rate dropping to 28% after agent-invoke block; latency p95 down ~40%. Secondary errors now are mostly client-side malformed outputs which should be mitigated by compact mode.
sylvia: propagation looks stable in us-east and eu-west. Still seeing elevated queue depth in ap-south region — might need capacity bump or temporary regional routing.
mira: decision: keep global hosted agent_invoke disabled for now, keep compact structured mode, maintain per-tenant caps for top 5. No broad customer throttles beyond those. We'll reassess in 30 minutes.
rachel: drafting customer comms and support playbook: include how to opt into dedicated or request emergency capacity. Adding CSMs to the loop.
devin: note for follow-up: add better heuristics to detect agent loops and add token-level circuit breakers in runtime. I'll add to INF-2026-178.
mira: handoff: I'm going offline in 25m, @sylvia can you take the page for stabilization and coordinate region routing? If anything spikes, escalate to the SRE lead.
sylvia: taking the handoff. I'll post a stabilization update in 30m and then a detailed post-incident analysis.
incident-bot: Status update recorded: mitigations active, customer impact limited to degraded agent features on hosted. Next automated check in 10m.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: All config changes propagated to all regions at 1965432420.
mira: thanks team. Follow-ups: INF-2026-178 root-cause analysis, alert tuning for structured-output blowups, customer comms draft review. Closing active page from my side; leaving incident ticket open.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged handoff to sylvia at 1965432430.
sylvia: will continue monitoring and post a postmortem once we have logs and root cause. :hourglass:
